definition: `IsPerfect InAct g`: whatever any being is in act in, g is in act in, formally or eminently (ST I q.4 a.2).
note: The case's reading of q.4 a.2's 'universaliter perfectus'. `InAct` covers being in act formally or virtually (DEF-IN-ACT-FORMALLY, DEF-IN-ACT-VIRTUALLY), which is how 'eminently' is kept.
